about_the_game:
This Radiant Royalty Pack includes 6 furniture items, 1 wallpaper, 1 flooring, 20 clothing items, and 4 wigs.

If you were born to shine, then this pack is for you! The Radiant Royalty Pack has 31 radiant rainbow-themed outfits and furniture items available for you to customize your characters and decorate your homes, sheds, and farms.

Pack includes:
  • Radiant Royalty Furniture Set: Radiant Royalty Flooring, Radiant Royalty Wallpaper, Radiant Royalty Window, Radiant Royalty Bed, Radiant Royalty Chair, Radiant Stained Glass End Table, Radiant Royalty End Table, Radiant Royalty Rug
  • Radiant Royalty Outfit Set: Radiant Royalty Helmet, Radiant Royalty Cape, Radiant Royalty Gloves, Radiant Royalty Chest Plate, Radiant Royalty Pants
  • Radiant Ribbon Outfit Set:Radiant Ribbon Hat, Radiant Ribbon Mask, Radiant Ribbon Gloves, Radiant Ribbon Shirt, Radiant Ribbon Pants
  • Radiant Queen Outfit Set: Radiant Queen Wig, Radiant Queen Dress
  • Radiant Royalty Princess Outfit Set: Radiant Royalty Princess Wig, Radiant Royalty Princess Dress
  • Dark Radiant Ruler Outfit Set: Dark Radiant Ruler Wig, Dark Radiant Ruler Wings, Dark Radiant Ruler Gloves, Dark Radiant Ruler Pants, Dark Radiant Ruler Dress
  • Dark Radiant Empress Outfit Set: Dark Radiant Empress Wig, Dark Radiant Empress Blouse, Dark Radiant Empress Pants, Dark Radiant Empress Cape
